description: Serializes and deserializes WireframeDocument to/from JSON. Uses camelCase keys, indented output (for AI readability), and ignores null optional fields. Safe to use in API or service projects. The JSON format is the canonical interchange format for wireframe documents — suitable for storage, REST APIs, and AI prompt injection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a WireframeDocument to indented camelCase JSON.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a WireframeDocument from JSON. Throws WireframeDeserializationException on failure.

methods.name: TryDeserialize
methods.description: Attempts to deserialize a WireframeDocument from JSON. Returns false (and out null) on failure instead of throwing.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: Deserialized document, or null on failure.

jsonFormat.notes: Extra unknown fields are ignored (forward-compatible). All keys are camelCase.
